category.name: E-commerce
category.description: Manage stores, products, orders and marketplace listings.

entries.name: Amazon Selling Partner API
entries.auth_hint: LWA (Login with Amazon) OAuth2 access token via x-amz-access-token header
entries.free_tier: free API access; requires an existing Amazon Seller/Vendor Central account
entries.desc_en: Manage listings, orders, inventory, and reports for an Amazon seller/vendor account via REST API.
entries.notes: Self-authorized (private) apps for your own seller account are relatively quick to set up; public apps serving other sellers require Amazon's app-approval review. Official MCP uses Seller Central OAuth consent. Orders v0 getOrders is deprecated; use searchOrders (v2026-01-01). Planned SP-API fees were cancelled

free_plan.quota: free API access (planned annual and usage fees cancelled)

rate_limits.summary: Token bucket per operation (rate per second + burst); standard and dynamic usage plans; 429 when empty

entries.name: BigCommerce API
entries.auth_hint: X-Auth-Token header (store API account) or OAuth2 for public apps
entries.free_tier: free API access; requires an active BigCommerce store plan
entries.desc_en: Manage catalog, orders, customers, and carts on a BigCommerce store via REST/GraphQL APIs.
entries.notes: Official Storefront MCP (early access; per-storefront URL, POST /api/mcp) searches the catalog, edits carts and creates checkout links. Vendor MCP at https://docs.bigcommerce.com/_mcp/server only searches the docs.

rate_limits.summary: Pro: 60k/hour (450/30 s); Standard and Plus: 20k/hour (150/30 s); Enterprise per plan

entries.name: eBay APIs
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token> (application or user token)
entries.free_tier: free developer tier with call-volume limits; sandbox environment included
entries.desc_en: List items, manage orders/inventory, and search listings across eBay marketplaces via REST APIs.
entries.notes: Production access requires an eBay developer account and app keys; rate limits scale with account compliance tier. Official MCP (npx @ebay/npm-public-api-mcp) runs locally, read-only (GET) in production.

entries.name: Etsy Open API v3
entries.free_tier: Free: developer keystring at no cost; rate limits (QPS/QPD) are set per app and shown in the Developer Portal
entries.desc_en: List products, manage orders/shop, and search listings on the Etsy marketplace via REST API.
entries.notes: Requires an approved Etsy developer app; OAuth2 user consent needed for shop-management scopes. Missing from candidate list despite being a major agent-callable marketplace API. Official Dev MCP covers the API spec only; it does not call the API.

auth_scheme.name: x-api-key
auth_scheme.format: x-api-key: <keystring>:<shared_secret> plus Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> for OAuth endpoints

rate_limits.summary: Per API key; current QPS/QPD limits shown in the Developer Portal and response headers (no fixed default published)

entries.name: Mercado Libre API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> obtained via OAuth 2.0 with the app's Client ID and Secret from DevCenter
entries.free_tier: Free API access for any Mercado Libre account that creates an app in DevCenter; only normal marketplace selling fees apply
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent search items and categories and manage a seller's listings, orders, questions, shipments and promotions on the Mercado Libre marketplace.
entries.notes: In AR, MX, BR and CL the account holder's details must be validated before creating an app; redirect URI must be HTTPS; rate limited (HTTP 429). Vendor MCP at https://mcp.mercadolibre.com/devsite/v1/mcp only searches the docs.

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Bearer APP_USR-<ACCESS_TOKEN> (token from https://api.mercadolibre.com/oauth/token, valid 6 hours)

entries.name: Printful API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <token> (Private token or OAuth2 for public apps)
entries.free_tier: free API access; pay only for products/fulfillment/shipping ordered
entries.desc_en: Create print-on-demand products, sync catalogs, and submit fulfillment orders via REST API.

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Bearer <PRIVATE_TOKEN> (account-level tokens also need X-PF-Store-Id)

rate_limits.summary: 120 API calls/min general limit; stricter for mockup generation; 60 s lockout when exceeded

async_jobs.how: mockup generator creates tasks processed asynchronously; poll the task result

entries.name: Shopify Admin / Storefront API
entries.auth_hint: X-Shopify-Access-Token header (custom app token or OAuth2 for public apps)
entries.free_tier: free API access; requires an active paid Shopify store subscription to use
entries.desc_en: Manage products, orders, customers, and inventory (Admin API) or build storefronts (Storefront API) via REST/GraphQL.
entries.notes: Official Storefront MCP per store (https://{shop}.myshopify.com/api/mcp, no auth) handles cart and policies, catalog tools at /api/ucp/mcp; Admin operations need an Admin API token. Dev MCP only searches docs.

rate_limits.summary: GraphQL Admin: calculated query cost, restore 100 pts/s Standard, 200 Advanced, 1000 Plus, 2000 enterprise

entries.name: WooCommerce REST API
entries.auth_hint: OAuth1.0a signature (HTTP) or Basic auth with Consumer Key/Secret (HTTPS)

mcp.issue: no MCP server listed in entry (mcp.url null)

entries.free_tier: free (self-hosted plugin; no vendor API fees, only your own WordPress hosting costs)
entries.desc_en: Manage products, orders, and customers on a self-hosted WooCommerce store via REST API.
entries.notes: Requires your own WordPress+WooCommerce installation; there is no shared multi-tenant cloud endpoint. Official MCP (developer preview) at /wp-json/mcp/mcp-adapter-default-server, auth via Application Passwords.

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Basic base64(<CONSUMER_KEY>:<CONSUMER_SECRET>) over HTTPS; OAuth 1.0a one-legged over HTTP
